description: A sprite sheet of SIX separate fruit trees arranged in a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell, growth from left to right (young sapling, grown tree, fruiting tree). Row 1 desert date palm: small young palm sprout with a few fronds, tall date palm with a rough trunk and green fronds, tall date palm with hanging orange-brown date clusters. Row 2 tropical coconut palm: small young palm sprout, tall curved coconut palm with green fronds, tall curved coconut palm with brown coconuts under the fronds. Each tree stands on a small sandy base, front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, natural colors, every tree fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no border, no frame

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
